title: Governed rollout workflow context and GitHub write-boundary repair

phases.objective: Allow the three governed rollout workflows to register and execute their authorized evidence phases without unavailable GitHub Actions contexts or repository-side status mutations.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow parser and governed rollout operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The Brand Skill, Sprint 69 Migration 1006, and response chunk ownership workflow contracts
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Each workflow can reach its exact authorization gate, use a valid evidence directory, preserve separate Apply or runtime confirmations, and emit no-secret Artifact and Job Summary evidence without writing to repository Issues.
steps: Validate Brand Skill typed bindings from repository root before checkout creates the service working directory.
Bind Sprint 69 readiness and Apply evidence to stable repository-relative directories.
Bind response chunk readiness, Apply, and runtime-closure evidence to stable repository-relative directories.
Remove GitHub Issue write permissions and API status-comment mutations from the two governed rollout workflows.
Publish bounded no-secret artifacts and GitHub Job Summaries while preserving exact readiness, Apply, and runtime authorization tokens.
Run the focused workflow contracts that reject unavailable contexts and repository write regressions.
assertions: No job-level EVIDENCE_DIR references runner.temp before a runner exists.
Brand Skill pre-checkout validation explicitly runs from repository root.
The Sprint 69 and response chunk workflows request contents:read only and contain no gh api mutation.
Readiness, Apply, and runtime-closure evidence directories are stable repository-relative paths.
Exact issue, association, and confirmation gates remain present and separate.
No SQL, migration Apply, provider call, credential read, deployment, Production mutation, or external business write is executed by these contract tests.

phases.objective: Observe fresh authorized readiness or staging runs after merge and validate the uploaded evidence artifacts.
Keep unavailable-context and repository-write regressions fail-closed through the focused contracts and repository lifecycle governance.
Validate a fresh checksum-bound non-Production staging or readiness execution using the repaired workflows.
This workflow repair grants no migration Apply, deployment, provider, credential, or Production authority.
